blind.description: A medieval open-faced helmet with an attached chainmail aventail. The helmet consists of a rounded conical bowl reinforced with metallic bands and a central ridge strip with rivets, open face section with cheek protectors, and a textured mail curtain hanging around the back and sides. Materials include dark aged steel with bronze/brass trim and detailed metallic chainmail links. Surfaces are clean, solid, and fully textured with no floating shards or untextured regions.
blind.from_above: A rounded oval dome with a brass/bronze median ridge running along the top, open facial cutout visible slightly at one end and chainmail trim flanking the rear rim, casting a soft shadow to the upper left.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1 foot tall and about 9 to 10 inches wide, approximately 1/5 to 1/6 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure, accurately scaled for a human head.
